notes: SUB-STUDY OF A MASTER PROTOCOL. This document is the intervention-specific appendix (ISA) H0P-MC-BP01 to Master Protocol H0P-MC-CPMP. PDF page 1 (cover sheet) does not name the master; the first page that does is the title page, PDF page 2, verbatim: "Master Protocol Title: A Master Protocol for Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, Phase 2 Clinical Trials of Multiple Interventions for the Treatment of Chronic Pain" / "Master Protocol Number: H0P-MC-CPMP". SoA page 9 (and SoA note T1:g1): "This SoA shows visits and procedures unique to the intervention-specific appendix (ISA) H0P-MC-BP01 (BP01) for LY3016859. Please refer to Master Protocol H0P-MC-CPMP (CPMP) and the CLBP disease-state addendum (DSA) H0P-MC-CPMP(2) SoAs for additional information." Nothing was filled from the master. Deferrals to the master (CPMP) / DSA CPMP(2): objectives and endpoints except the tertiary/exploratory ones (p6, p18); overall design (p19); eligibility (p21); discontinuation (p26); procedures and timing (p27); early-discontinuation procedures (p20); statistics, populations, primary endpoint (p30-31); sample retention (CPMP Appendix 1, Section 10.1.12, p29); laboratory tests beyond those unique to BP01 (p32: 'The CPMP Master Protocol describes tests that may be performed at additional times noted in the SoA for this ISA.'). SoA activities whose content this document does not describe and that are therefore deferred to the master: Hematology, Urinalysis, Urine drug screen, Hemoglobin A1c (not in the BP01 lab table, p32); NRS, PGI, RMDQ (only name, abbreviation and, for NRS, diary/device use stated here; versions, recall periods, scoring and mode are in the master/DSA - SoA note p10-11 refers to 'the CPMP SoA'); C-SSRS, Self-Harm Supplement Form, Self-Harm Follow-up Form (only names and the C-SSRS 'Since Last Visit version' note); Weight (SoA row only, no description); Adverse events, Concomitant medication, Rescue medication usage reporting (SoA rows; not measurements/instruments; body text p15, p24-28 gives no category content). Chemistry SoA row: BP01 lab table adds only Cystatin-C; other chemistry analytes, if any, are in the master. CROSS-REFERENCES: soa_cross_references input is empty, so cross_references is []. RULE 10: the lab-tests table on PDF page 32 (Appendix 1) runs its three columns together in the text layer; it was read from the page image (page_32.png). The image confirmed the panel assignment: Chemistry = Cystatin-C; Urine Chemistries = Albumin, Creatinine, ACR, Protein, PCR; Other Tests = Immunogenicity, Epiregulin, LY3016859 concentration, Urine pregnancy. The image also shows a lone '.' in the Chemistry column (row of Protein / Urine pregnancy), also present in the text layer; it is not an analyte and was not recorded (possibly a redaction remnant). The hypersensitivity lab table (p36, Appendix 3) reads in order in the text layer; specimens there are given per test (serum for tryptase/BAT, urine for NMH) so the panel specimen is null. No page lacks a text layer (rule 8 not used). RULE 11: the PDF holds one version only - the original protocol ('Amendment Number: This is the original protocol.', Approval Date 11-May-2020, p2); no amendments in the PDF. VARIANTS / CONFLICTS: ADA is defined as 'anti-drug antibody' (p12, p36, p37) and 'anti-drug antibodies' (p16); PK as 'pharmacokinetic' (p12, p36), 'pharmacokinetic(s)' (p38) and 'pharmacokinetics' (p18); PD as 'pharmacodynamic(s)' (p38) and 'pharmacodynamics' (p18) - SoA and lab-table definitions recorded with their own pages. The ECG section (p27) lists 'pulse rate' among the intervals measured, recorded as printed. Pregnancy testing: serum test at screening and urine test within 24 hours prior to exposure (p33); SoA note says V3 sample before dosing. Immunogenicity body text says 'predose venous blood samples' (p29) while the SoA collects ADA samples also at V7-V803 (no pre/post-dose timing there). The abbreviations appendix is numbered 'Appendix 9' (Section 10.4) and Section 8.6 heading is redacted (CCI). Abbreviation lists under other tables (p7, p8, p16, p18, p23) were not repeated; ED, V, PGI and RMDQ are defined only under the SoA table (p12). Tokens in SoA activity names not defined in any abbreviation list: 'A1c' (Hemoglobin A1c). All other tokens (ECG, IV, NRS, PGI, RMDQ, C-SSRS, PK, ADA) are defined. Measurements: Weight has no described content; not recorded. Updated 2026-11-07 to schema 1.1 (no re-extraction): instruments carry kind.
